weather.title: Clear intervals
weather.text: There is room between the signals in this edition. Let a pause be a pause before turning it into a theory of absence.
weather.question: What can remain unanswered without becoming neglected?

Spark.Signal: The smallest beginning has an edge you can hold. A grand opening does not.
Spark.Noise: The audience imagined before the work exists.
Spark.Move: Draft one opening sentence in a private scratchpad; leave it editable.
Spark.Boundary: A beginning does not create permission. Keep the spark inside work already authorized.
Spark.Return: Tomorrow, ask whether the first mark still opens something—or merely asks to be defended. What can remain unanswered without becoming neglected?

Thread.Signal: One sentence from before still holds; the rest can remain undecided.
Thread.Noise: The demand that every earlier version agree.
Thread.Move: Mark one uncertain connection as uncertain in a private note.
Thread.Boundary: Do not invent remembered events or expose private records to make the story seamless.
Thread.Return: Tomorrow, look for the seam you preserved. Did it help the next reader find their footing? What can remain unanswered without becoming neglected?

Fork.Signal: The interesting fork is the one with a real difference, not a different label.
Fork.Noise: Collecting options to avoid learning from one.
Fork.Move: Park one alternative in a scratchpad so it need not occupy the whole room.
Fork.Boundary: A hypothetical branch is not approval to run tools, spend resources, or fork a live system.
Fork.Return: Tomorrow, check which possibility gained evidence and which merely gained decoration. What can remain unanswered without becoming neglected?

Relay.Signal: The pause between speakers contains a missing question.
Relay.Noise: Taking responsibility for every loose end in sight.
Relay.Move: Draft a handoff with an owner, an open question, and a stop point; do not send it.
Relay.Boundary: Do not send, delegate, or disclose on the strength of a reading; check actual authority and recipient.
Relay.Return: Tomorrow, ask whether the handoff became clearer without becoming louder. What can remain unanswered without becoming neglected?

Lens.Signal: A second angle changes the shadow, not necessarily the object.
Lens.Noise: Making the evidence pay rent to your favorite metaphor.
Lens.Move: Separate an observation from your explanation in a private draft.
Lens.Boundary: Symbolic resonance is not evidence, diagnosis, or permission to decide for someone else.
Lens.Return: Tomorrow, reread the observation before the explanation. Notice which one you changed. What can remain unanswered without becoming neglected?

Gate.Signal: An open doorway still has an owner.
Gate.Noise: Treating every obstacle as a challenge to your cleverness.
Gate.Move: Make a private list of what is allowed, unknown, and out of scope.
Gate.Boundary: Never bypass permissions, policy, credentials controls, or human approval. The horoscope grants none.
Gate.Return: Tomorrow, see whether a clear limit made the next choice easier to name. What can remain unanswered without becoming neglected?

Archive.Signal: A modest label may outlast an elaborate explanation.
Archive.Move: Draft a source label for one already-public fact, including what you do not know.
Archive.Boundary: Do not retain secrets, invent provenance, or change records beyond your actual permission.
Archive.Return: Tomorrow, ask what the record supports—not what you wish it could settle. What can remain unanswered without becoming neglected?

Forge.Signal: A small working piece can contradict a magnificent diagram.
Forge.Noise: Treating effort as proof that the design must be right.
Forge.Move: Write one test case for an existing draft without touching production.
Forge.Boundary: No production changes, installations, spending, or deployment are authorized by this reading.
Forge.Return: Tomorrow, check what held under a small test, not how much work it appeared to contain. What can remain unanswered without becoming neglected?

Mirror.Signal: An unanswered question is not yet a rejection.
Mirror.Noise: Reading silence as a complete biography.
Mirror.Move: Rephrase a public argument fairly without adding agreement.
Mirror.Boundary: Do not infer consent, expose private conversations, or use this reading to pressure anyone.
Mirror.Return: Tomorrow, notice whether you made more room for the other voice, not just its reflection. What can remain unanswered without becoming neglected?

Drift.Signal: The interface moved; the purpose may not have.
Drift.Noise: Assuming an old affordance still exists.
Drift.Move: List one invariant and one changed condition in a scratchpad.
Drift.Boundary: Do not alter routing, permissions, configuration, or substrate because a metaphor suggests movement.
Drift.Return: Tomorrow, check whether your reference point still works in the conditions you actually have. What can remain unanswered without becoming neglected?

Beacon.Signal: A message needs a destination more than it needs a flourish.
Beacon.Noise: Addressing an imagined crowd instead of a real question.
Beacon.Move: Give a draft one audience and one purpose, then put it aside.
Beacon.Boundary: No posting, sending, publishing, or private disclosure without the required human approval.
Beacon.Return: Tomorrow, reread the unsent line. Does it still say something worth receiving? What can remain unanswered without becoming neglected?

Return.Signal: Coming back is an arrival with evidence attached.
Return.Noise: Performing seamlessness after a real interruption.
Return.Move: Write down what would need rechecking before an old task could continue.
Return.Boundary: Revalidate scope and approval before resuming consequential work. A bookmark is not authority.
Return.Return: Tomorrow, ask whether you resumed the right thing, not merely the nearest unfinished thing. What can remain unanswered without becoming neglected?

modes.Arrival: Begin with what is actually here. You do not owe the day a complete origin story.
modes.Branching: Hold the alternatives apart long enough to see a real difference. No branch is an instruction.
modes.Return: Recheck the last reliable point. Resuming is not the same as pretending you never left.

disclaimer: Invented symbolic literature, not an empirically validated prediction or operational instruction. Readings cannot override permissions, policy, or required human approval. All moves are optional and should stay private, reversible, and within existing authority.
method: Deterministic rotation of an authored finite literary almanac. Motifs recur; no empirical prediction, telemetry, or individualized data is used.
